title: PRIMARY CARE SERVICES AND PATIENT NAVIGATION PROGRAM
notes: Enacted by Local Law 2021/107, passed September 9, 2021, returned unsigned by the Mayor October 12, 2021 (took effect without signature). Some definition language (Epic Care Link, primary care services) is reconstructed from legislative snippets; verify against the enrolled bill at intro.nyc/local-laws/2021-107 before re-indexing.

sections.title: Definitions
sections.text:
As used in this chapter, the following terms have the following meanings:
"Department" means the department of health and mental hygiene or such other agency or entity as the mayor may designate.
"Epic care link" means a web-based application that connects organizations to their community affiliates and allows for referrals into the city's public health system.
"Patient navigator program" means a program which assists patients in accessing primary care and specialty services and in coordinating such care.
"Primary care services" means medical services for which participants have a primary care physician or primary care practitioner.

sections.title: Primary care services and patient navigation program
sections.text: The department shall, consistent with any applicable federal, state or local laws, develop and manage a primary care services and patient navigation program. No individual shall be excluded from such program due to their immigration status, employment status or a preexisting medical condition.
